protocols: W3C Trace Context through host OpenTelemetry configuration

observation.coverage_basis: In-process decision, LLM, and tool spans with host-reported recorder primitives. No framework, control, evaluation, or sidecar I/O implementation ships in this package, and it does not materialize Activity Envelope v2.

authentication.credential_handling: The package accepts no Fabric service credential; exporter authentication is configured by the host application.

correlation_limitations: The explicit start/end API does not automatically parent child spans; the callback API is required for automatic nesting.
Framework, policy, guardrail, and MCP behavior is visible only when the host records it.

verification_evidence.claim: Proves the package root and Decision prototype exclude runtime-control and evaluation surfaces.
Exercises recorder decision, LLM, tool, content, and correlation behavior.
Qualifies and smoke-installs the exact npm artifact for ESM, CommonJS, and TypeScript consumers.

known_blind_spots: No framework adapters or MCP wrappers ship in the TypeScript package, so those operations require explicit host instrumentation.
Tenant and agent identifiers are non-empty caller assertions and are not cryptographically verified.
Optional raw content capture has no built-in redactor and must be governed before exporter egress.
The SDK emits OpenTelemetry and does not materialize Activity Envelope v2, privacy assertions, delivery receipts, durable retention, or immutable evidence.
